content.title: Where to Watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards: How to Stream Online
content.text: Skip to main content Skip to header navigation optional screen reader Where to Watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards: How to Stream Online March 26, 2026 at 5:57pm EDT Taylor Swift at the 2023 iHeartRadio Music Awards Christopher Polk/Variety via Getty Images If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, SheKnows may receive an affiliate commission. Tonight’s essential viewing is the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards, and if you’ve cut the cord, we’ve got details about where to stream the show without cable The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards will take place on Thursday, March 26, at 8 p.m. ET and will air live from the Dolby Theater. Performers include Alex Warren, Lainey Wilson, RAYE, and Kehlani, as well as host Ludacris. For the first time together, TLC, Salt-N-Pepa and En Vogue will perform together. Taylor Swift is confirmed to be in attendance and leads the nominations with nine nods, followed by Bad Bunny, Sabrina Carpenter and Alex Warren with eight each. Other major nominees include Sabrina Carpenter, KATSEYE, Doechii, and more. Related story Taylor Swift Is Set To Mark Her First Major Appearance of the Year at This Significant Event Miley Cyrus will receive the Innovator Award, and John Mellencamp will be recognized with the Icon Award. Where to Watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards The 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards are available to watch on Fox at 8 p.m. ET on Thursday, March 26. If you don’t have cable, Fox is available in select markets through Sling when you sign up for their Sling Blue, Sling Orange & Blue, or Sling Select plans. Sling does not have free trial options. 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards at a Glance When – Thursday, March 26 at 8 p.m. ET (PT tape-delayed) Where to Stream – Sling Blue, Sling Orange & Blue, or Sling Select plans Network – Fox Our mission at SheKnows is to empower and inspire women, and we only feature products we think you’ll love as much as we do. This article was sponsored by Sling TV. However, all products were independently selected by our editors. Please note that if you purchase something by clicking on a link within this story, we may receive a small commission from the sale. How to Watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards on Sling To watch the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards on Sling, you’ll need to sign up for the Sling Blue, Sling Orange & Blue, or Sling Select plans. Fox is available in select markets through these Sling plans. Sling Blue costs $45.99 a month and includes 40+ channels along with Fox, such as CNN, TNT, NFL Network, Bravo, NBC and more. Sling Orange & Blue starts at $29.99 for your first month and costs $60.99 after that. It gives you access to 50+ channels, including ESPN, NFL Network, USA, TNT, Bravo, FOX News, CNN, and more. Sling Select starts at $19.99 per month and offers a smaller selection of 10+ channels, including NFL Network, National Geographic, FS1, FOX News, and more. Sling 1. Visit Sling.com/Service/Compare-Plans2. Input your ZIP code to ensure Fox is available3. Choose your plan4. Click “Buy Plan”3. Enter your information and payment method4. Search for Fox and start watching the iHeartRadio Music Awards Who Are The iHeartRadio Music Awards Nominees? Nominees at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Awards include Taylor Swift, Bad Bunny, Alex Warren, Sabrina Carpenter, Morgan Wallen and Tate McRae. Song of the Year Nominees: “Anxiety” – Doechii “Good News” – Shaboozey “Love Somebody” – Morgan Wallen “luther” – Kendrick Lamar and SZA “Manchild” – Sabrina Carpenter “MUTT” – Leon Thomas “Ordinary” – Alex Warren “Sorry I’m Here For Someone Else” – Benson Boone “Stargazing” – Myles Smith “The Fate of Ophelia” – Taylor Swift Artist of the Year Nominees: Bad Bunny Benson Boone Chris Brown Jelly Roll Kendrick Lamar Lady Gaga Morgan Wallen Sabrina Carpenter Tate McRae Taylor Swift Who Is Performing at the 2026 iHeart Radio Music Awards?
